dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place seems to have its secrets after all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shh! Listen. There are people talking over there.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Sergeant
dialogues.text: Gah. Never expected that woman's lips to be sealed up so tight. Not a peep from her at all!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui-Aligned Ronin
dialogues.text: Not to worry, sirs. Interrogation is our specialty. Take a break. We'll take care of this in a moment!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Sergeant
dialogues.text: We haven't much time left. The Teacher wants to know how much she knows about our plans, and he wants to know now — or we'll be in hot soup too!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui-Aligned Ronin
dialogues.text: Gah. His temper is really... something. What in the world did that woman do to anger him so?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Sergeant
dialogues.text: The Teacher's latest plans have this person named Lyudochka as a critical piece. But this Shuumatsuban woman took her out!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Sergeant
dialogues.text: Fortunately, the fire hadn't quite gone out when we rushed in. The Teacher, sharp-eyed as he is, identified Lyudochka from her clothes right away and recognized that our plans might be at risk.

dialogues.speaker: Fatui-Aligned Ronin
dialogues.text: Bad as that might have been, he really salvaged things, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Sergeant
dialogues.text: Still, we don't know how much of our plans this woman is privy to, or if she's informed anyone else in the Shuumatsuban yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like Momoyo is locked up in an underground cell. Let's get her outta there!

dialogues.speaker: Pavel
dialogues.text: Agh, I never thought that our operational plans would be leaked. That's some awful luck!

dialogues.speaker: Ilyin
dialogues.text: Exactly! Also, I heard that the Teacher was summoned back to Snezhnaya, but that the Watatsumi Island operation is still going ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyin
dialogues.text: Don't you think the Teacher is acting a bit too independently? He didn't report this operation to Lady Arlecchino, did he?

dialogues.speaker: Pavel
dialogues.text: That's true. This is his own idea. You know what? I've got a bad feeling about this...

dialogues.speaker: Ilyin
dialogues.text: Are you saying that if we fail, the Teacher's just going to pin all the blame on us?
